contract: Malformed array paths are safe no-ops; valid and literal object paths retain intended behavior through public consumers.
oracle_sources: ../rfc6901.txt, section 4, canonical decimal array tokens and decoded reference tokens
../rfc6902.txt, sections 4.4 and 4.5, source existence and move ordering
../contract.json, A1-A4, product no-op and progressive batching extensions
JavaScript observation of own keys, array length, object identity, callback payloads and rendered state
equivalence_rules: Invalid decimal spellings share rejection behavior, but each spelling below is separately faulted to ensure the rejection is protected.
Leaf versus intermediate invalid tokens are separate classes because intermediate writes could partially create containers.
Store and adapter identities and counts must be observed separately from equal JSON values.
Compiler success is a proxy for renderer safety; both public boundaries must reject malformed compound operations.
Successful batches do not prove accurate change records; callbacks and rendered state are observed independently.
exclusions: No claim of full RFC 6902 conformance: pre-existing root aliases, missing-parent creation, descendant moves, shallow copy behavior, and add bounds are outside this diff.
No giant dense array is allocated: the upper canonical bound is tested as a sparse read or own-property classification.
No cross-platform browser claim: React was exercised in jsdom on macOS Node; other renderer dispatchers are statically traced only.
Hostile accessor, Proxy, frozen-container, and cyclic object behavior belongs to the Resilience and Security receipts; this receipt does not infer safety for those inputs.
smallest_faults: Accept one invalid array token as index 1.
Remove move destination preflight at the compound operation call site.
Remove copy source validation at the compound operation call site.
Apply the unchanged renderer compound dispatcher to newly rejected core paths.
Emit every submitted changed value after core rejects part of a mixed batch.
process_note: This model was assembled after inherited review context exposed the implementation; oracle expectations come from the listed contract and normative texts, not the implementation output.
